frequency_source: Purple Book Chapter 3 Tables 3.8/3.9; generic pump default; applicability review required
scope: one native liquid MappedPump outlet bound to one TNO pump G2 opening; G1 full-bore and non-modeled pump exposures remain uncomputed
limitations: native source state, H-Q-N map, reserve and isolation boundary are synthetic diagnostic inputs
TNO pump frequency is a generic industrial default and is not an empirically validated LH2 rate
the pump does not own upstream inventory or field valve reliability
airborne liquid remains zero under the native provider contract
conditional IR/F-N is diagnostic and does not promote facility-total QRA
